summary: Python tool that uses AI/ML to convert screenshot images into clean, responsive code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue) for rapid prototyping.
usecases: Quickly turn UI mockups or designs into implementable frontend code.
Generate codebases for new web pages from hand-drawn sketches or screenshots.
Assist developers in refactoring legacy interfaces by converting UI snapshots.
ideas: Integrate with design tools like Figma or Sketch via API for automated code generation.
Combine with a component library generator to output consistent UI kits.
Build a no-code platform where users upload screenshots and get fully functional React apps.
